title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial for the health of both mother and baby. However, with a busy lifestyle, preparing meals can be a challenge. In this article, we will introduce 5 cook-once recipes that help pregnant women have delicious and nutritious dinners.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are designed to provide enough protein, fiber, and calcium for pregnant women. Protein helps build and repair body tissues, fiber supports digestive health, and calcium helps develop bones and teeth for the baby.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken Soup with Vegetables
Chicken soup is a traditional Vietnamese dish, rich in protein and fiber. To cook chicken soup, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of cooking oil

Cook chicken soup with vegetables and serve with steamed rice.

### 2. Beef Stir-Fry with Broccoli
Beef stir-fry with broccoli is a simple and quick recipe. To cook beef stir-fry, you need:
- 200g beef
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 carrot
- 1 potato
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of cooking oil

Stir-fry beef with broccoli and serve with steamed rice.

### 3. Fried Eggs with Salad
Fried eggs with salad is a simple and protein-rich recipe. To cook fried eggs, you need:
- 2 eggs
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 carrot
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of cooking oil

Cook fried eggs and serve with salad.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait with fruit is a simple and calcium-rich recipe. To cook yogurt parfait, you need:
- 1 cup of yogurt
- 1 cup of fruit
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 1 teaspoon of cooking oil

Cook yogurt parfait with fruit and serve.

### 5. Grilled Chicken with Vegetables
Grilled chicken with vegetables is a simple and protein-rich recipe. To cook grilled chicken, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of cooking oil

Grill chicken with vegetables and serve.

## Practical Tips
- Use fresh and clean ingredients to ensure food safety.
- Cook with oil and spices to enhance flavor.
- Serve with steamed rice or salad to increase nutrition.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about your diet or health, consult your doctor or a nutritionist.
